research_rationale:
EO 12891 (signed 1994-01-15; 59 FR 2935) was read in the held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12891.txt (PDF pages 21-29 of the capture; the order occupies the first pages and later pages belong to neighbouring documents). The dossier evidence ACT:EO:12891>EO:13062 was re-read against the held EO 13062 text: section 3(a) revokes EO 12891 by number and subject, and section 7 gives the express effective date 1997-09-30. The 18 clauses in the inventory were compared with the order’s sections 1 to 4 and cover each subsection and item. Machine searches read: U.S. Code 0 hits, eCFR 0 hits, Federal Register catalog hits not decisive. The LOOKUPS number search finds EO 13062 and its source-ladder copy as the only other texts citing EO 12891. Under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on report deadlines, section 4(b) (termination 30 days after the final report) is report-relative: the final report date is not held and the express revocation is the end, with the recital in EO 13062 that its listed committees have terminated and completed their work disclosed.
